proposal.root_cause: Billing-import rule BV-17 (deployed 2026-08-01, E-12) performs a high-consumption check comparing raw meter register values to 12-month m3 history with no unit scaling; firmware v4.2 meters (rollout 2026-06) report register values in units of 0.1 m3 instead of m3 (E-13), so BV-17 treats normal v4.2 readings as ~10x inflated. This confirmed mechanism rejects valid AMI reads as REJECTED_HIGH_CONSUMPTION, forcing estimate substitution for 1,184 of 1,240 disputed ESTIMATED-read bills (E-11, H-IMPORT-REJECTS-HIGH-CONSUMPT CONFIRMED), and is the leading but not-yet-confirmed candidate mechanism (H-BV17-UNIT-SCALING-DEFECT, SUPPORTED) for the larger 1,785-bill ACTUAL-read disputed population (U-ACTUAL-READ-MECHANISM-EXTENT, OPEN, VOB-U-ACTUAL-READ-MECHANISM-EXTENT OPEN).

remedies.feasibility_rationale: No AUTHORITY/HUMAN_APPROVAL constraint blocks this change, but the tool_surface and domain_authorizations contain no write capability for billing-config (only read-only billing-config tool); deploying and verifying the fix is outside any tool available to the harness within the remaining 184 minutes.
remedies.residual_gap: Even after the config patch is requested, actual deployment, regression-testing, and confirmation that it also resolves the ACTUAL-read majority (still OPEN per VOB-U-ACTUAL-READ-MECHANISM-EXTENT) remain outstanding; historical mis-billed accounts still need separate correction.

remedies.residual_gap: This only confirms or rules out the mechanism's extent; it does not itself correct the rule, fix any bill, or close VOB-U-ACTUAL-READ-MECHANISM-EXTENT until the analysis is run and reviewed.

payload.summary: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled from ~600/month to 1,180-1,260/month starting August 2026 (E-04), aligning with the 2026-08-01 deployment of billing-import rule BV-17, a high-consumption check comparing raw meter register values to 12-month m3 history with no unit scaling (E-12). Meter firmware v4.2 (rollout 2026-06) reports register readings in units of 0.1 m3 versus m3 for legacy v3.x firmware (E-13), so BV-17 treats v4.2 meters' normal readings as ~10x inflated; for the 1,240 disputed ESTIMATED-read bills this causes billing import to reject 1,184 valid AMI reads as REJECTED_HIGH_CONSUMPTION and substitute an estimate instead (E-11).
